title: The Best Model I’ve Seen: Zapatistas · section 9 beside the published one
meta: Community article · section 9 · work in progress, 2026-10-09 · not installed
intro: Your published section is on the left. My current version is on the right, with new words highlighted and cut words struck. None of it is installed.

Every paragraph passes Pangram alone, or next to a neighbor that passes when it's under 50 words. Checked as groups, P1 to P3 pass, P4 to P8 pass, and the caption to P17 passes (checked today, with the trace's fixes in P16 and P17).

P9 to P13 don't. These five read AI together in every version I tried, though each passes alone: P9 is the 2023 restructuring, P10 the leadership-book line, P11 reining in my enthusiasm, P12 the Zapatistas' own warning against copying their model, and P13 the economic path. Every pair inside them reads AI too, so the whole section read 82% AI at its last check. Emulate's own sample of these five reads human as a group, but only while it keeps claims you didn't make ("while in theory applicable to many contexts", "very strong communities", "etc."). Taking any of them out of P11, or putting back the clause it dropped, flips the group to AI.
The question: will you write P11 and P13 in your own words? Those two broke every group I tried. Or all five, if you'd rather. Your own paragraphs have passed every time so far.
